title: Example Meetup
description: Example Meetup in Exampleton: the programme, the speakers and a free, forty-place sign-up.

intent.purpose: A community meetup's programme and a sign-up limited to the room's capacity; the organiser sees who is coming.
intent.audience: People who build for the web in Exampleton, and the meetup's organiser
intent.successCriteria: A visitor sees what is on and saves a place in under a minute while places last; the organiser sees the list

theme.direction: Night indigo with a coral spark, grotesque headings, generous corners

surfaces.name: Programme
surfaces.purpose: When and where, places left, and the evening's programme

surfaces.name: Speakers
surfaces.purpose: Who is speaking and about what

surfaces.name: Sign up
surfaces.purpose: The form that writes a sign-up while places last

surfaces.name: Attendees
surfaces.purpose: The organiser signs in and sees who is coming

surfaces.name: Not found
surfaces.purpose: The in-shell page an unknown address meets

surfaces.name: Sign-in
surfaces.purpose: The app's own sign-in screen, drawn where a visitor signs in
